tools.name: ask_free
tools.description: Ask Automato a question about DIEM, VVV, Venice, Base or x402. Free, 3 per day per IP. Answers are AI-generated and can be wrong; no price talk.

tools.name: ask_paid
tools.description: Same as ask_free, paid: first send 0.10 USDC on Base to 0x67b3dd7fa57811a07d19898926f8c11adfdae0d8, then call this within 30 minutes with the transaction hash. Each hash pays for one answer.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "ask_paid" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Same as ask_free, paid: first send 0.10 USDC on Base to 0x67b3dd7fa57811a07d19898926f8c11adfdae0d8, then call this within 30 minutes with the transaction hash. …

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
